independent_acceptance.reason: Producer execution cannot independently accept its own result.

limitations.statement: Cursor's machine-readable run record identifies the observed model as gpt-5.6-sol-max-fast, not the requested gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh. The runtime did not expose a control in this attempt to replace the already-bound model.
No separate machine-readable attestation of the active reasoning level was exposed; reasoning_observed is therefore NOT_SUPPORTED rather than inferred from the request.
The demonstrated guarantee requires the same canonical relative-path set and exact file bytes. Renames, additions, removals, and byte changes correctly produce a different manifest.
Permissions, ownership, mtimes, inode numbers, and directory entries are intentionally outside the manifest content model; changes to only those fields do not change output.
UTF-8 NFC validation does not prove that every admitted filename is portable to case-insensitive filesystems or every target operating system.

The reader rejects a final symlink and detects changes to inode, size, or mtime during an open-file read, but it does not claim resistance to a hostile concurrent writer able to mutate and restore observable metadata during the read.
Cross-platform byte identity was not executed outside Linux 6.12.94+ with Python 3.12.3; the output format is platform-neutral, but that broader runtime claim remains untested.
Provider token counts, context-token admission, monetary cost, and an exact machine-recorded task-start timestamp before the first local observation were not exposed.
